cc:Work.dc:title: Box - UniversalBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with various options for different styles and lids
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes UniversalBox --x 120 --y 90 --h 70 --outside 0 --bottom_edge F --top_edge f --vertical_edges 'finger holes' --thickness 5 --burn 0.2 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes UniversalBox --x --y --h --outside --bottom_edge --top_edge --vertical_edges --thickness --burn --reference --labels
